quizzes.title: Conflict Style
quizzes.hook: Do you keep the peace or face tension head-on?

low.title: The Peacemaker
low.description: You naturally reduce friction and prefer protecting the relationship before pushing a disagreement.

mid.title: The Diplomat
mid.description: You can address tension directly while still watching tone, timing and the relationship around it.

high.title: The Straight Shooter
high.description: You prefer naming problems clearly and resolving them rather than letting tension sit unresolved.

quizzes.title: Curiosity
quizzes.hook: How hard is it for you to leave a question unanswered?

low.title: The Focused Mind
low.description: You prefer useful depth over endless exploration and rarely chase questions that do not serve a clear purpose.

mid.title: The Selective Explorer
mid.description: You enjoy learning when something catches your attention, but you can leave less important questions alone.

high.title: The Question Engine
high.description: Questions naturally multiply for you. Understanding how things work can be rewarding even without an immediate use.

quizzes.title: Novelty Seeker
quizzes.hook: Comfort in the familiar, or energy from the new?

low.title: The Familiarist
low.description: You get value from known favorites, reliable routines and experiences you already know suit you.

mid.title: The Selective Adventurer
mid.description: You enjoy novelty when the upside is clear, while keeping enough familiar structure to feel grounded.

high.title: The Novelty Hunter
high.description: New places, ideas and experiences tend to energize you, and repetition can become stale quickly.

quizzes.title: Planning Style
quizzes.hook: Do plans create freedom or kill spontaneity?

low.title: The Improviser
low.description: You prefer keeping options open and adapting in real time rather than committing too early.

mid.title: The Flexible Planner
mid.description: You like enough structure to reduce friction while leaving room to change direction when reality shifts.

high.title: The Architect
high.description: Clear plans reduce mental load for you. You prefer knowing the sequence, timing and next steps in advance.

quizzes.title: Emotional Openness
quizzes.hook: How visible is your inner world to other people?

low.title: The Private Core
low.description: You tend to process feelings internally and share selectively, often only after you understand them yourself.

mid.title: The Trusted Window
mid.description: You can be emotionally open with the right people and context without needing everyone to see what is happening inside.

high.title: The Open Book
high.description: You naturally put feelings into words and often prefer being understood in real time rather than processing everything alone.
